mechanism: Amikacin (aminoglycoside) carries nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity risk; tamoxifen may increase fluid retention and electrolyte disturbances, potentially potentiating aminoglycoside toxicity in vulnerable renal function.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) and electrolytes regularly during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration and consider baseline audiometry if prolonged amikacin therapy is necessary.
